title.line2: One stolen key shouldn't cost you every chain.
title.line3: Reactive Omni hackathon  |  Set It and Forget It

end.line3: Reactive Omni hackathon  |  Base, Ethereum and Unichain Sepolia

scenes.intro:
Tripwire watches a hot wallet on three chains. When something it can't explain
leaves the wallet, it moves everything else to your cold address.
scenes.guarded:
A reactive contract on Reactive Network watches the wallet. Each chain has a Guardian
that can only ever pay one address: the cold wallet.
scenes.normal:
Normal use: the second key pre-clears one payment, the payment goes through,
and Tripwire stays quiet.
scenes.attack:
The attack: the wallet signs a phishing approval for a drainer contract.
An unknown spender, nothing pre-cleared: the contract trips.
scenes.sweeps:
Reactive Network asks every chain's Guardian to sweep.
Origin to last sweep: {{LAT_LAST_SWEEP}} s in this run.
scenes.pull: When the drainer comes back to pull, there is nothing left to take.
scenes.proof:
Every step is an ordinary transaction: the approval on the origin chain,
the reaction on Lasna, the sweep callbacks on each chain.
scenes.latency:
Measured from block timestamps. Median over {{RUNS}} runs: {{LAT_P50}} s,
p95 {{LAT_P95}} s.
scenes.outro:
The first move still lands. Tripwire saves everything else, on every chain,
with no server and no keeper key to run.
